Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small, ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Chondral heterogeneity with low-grade fraying. No high-grade cartilage defect.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade chondral fissuring at the lateral patellar facet with subchondral cystic change and edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Iliotibial band, fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon are normal. There is moderate proximal popliteus tendinosis.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Mild proximal patellar tendinosis.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Severe edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 6 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Findings of lateral patellofemoral maltracking with severe Hoffa's fat pad impingement, high-grade chondral fissuring at the lateral patellar facet, and mild patellar tendinosis.
2. Moderate proximal popliteus tendinosis.
3. Small, ruptured Baker's cyst.

Technique: MRI of the knee. ACL normal. MCL normal. Medial meniscus tear. Lateral meniscus normal.  OA of medial compartment. No Baker's cyst. No effusion. Coclusion: Medial meniscus tear. OA of medial compartment.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Rodilla traumática. Esguince medial. Obs. Lesión del LCA.
Hallazgos:
Aumento de señal sugiriendo transformación quística parcial del LCA, sin criterios que sugieran
una rotura categórica. LCP y ligamentos colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos categóricos de rotura.
Úlcera condral de espesor total de la región central posterior del cóndilo femoral medial con
cambios óseos secundarios. Mide aproximadamente 2 x 3 mm.
Foco de edema óseo de la región postero central del platillo tibial lateral con pequeña fractura
trabecular regional. No se observan otras alteraciones de señal de la médula ósea. No se
observan otras alteraciones condrales de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemorales.
Leve derrame articular con sinovitis difusa. Quiste poplíteo con discreta filtración hacia caudal.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Aumento de señal sugieren transformación quística parcial del LCA. No hay signos categóricos de
rotura.
Condropatía focal grado 4 de la región central posterior del cóndilo femoral medial.
Foco edema óseo la región postero central del platillo tibial lateral con pequeña fractura trabecular
regional.
Leve derrame articular con sinovitis difusa. Quiste poplíteo con fenómenos de filtración

3. Mild synovitis of left knee.
4. R/O paratendinitis of pes anserinus.
5. Grade 1 injury of ACL and MCL.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:

Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Reduced patellofemoral joint space with subchondral erosions and thinning of the cartilage.

Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

1.	Baker's cyst as described above.
2.	Tricompartmental arthritic changes in the form of reduced medial tibiofemoral joint space with subjacent marrow edema, thinning of the cartilage and marginal osteophytes.

No hay evidente derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Leve engrosamiento y aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de
rotura. Discretos cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Discreto edema de las partes blandas entre la banda de tibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral
sugiriendo fenómenos de fricción regional.
Impresión:
Condropatía superficial de la región central de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal. Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales.
Fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial, correlacionar con clínica.
